Test Case Description: Verify the application loads successfully
Test Steps: 1. Open the SauceDemo application
Expected Result: Login page should be displayed

Test Case Description: Verify user can log in with valid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username and password 2. Click Login
Expected Result: Products page should be displayed

Test Case Description: Verify products are displayed after login
Test Steps: 1. Review the Products page
Expected Result: Product list should be displayed correctly

Test Case Description: Verify a product can be added to the shopping cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and Products page is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Select a product 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Selected product should appear in the cart

Test Case Description: Verify checkout workflow can be initiated
Test Steps: 1. Open the cart 2. Click Checkout
Expected Result: Checkout information page should be displayed

Test Case Description: Verify valid user login
Test Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter valid password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User should successfully log in and Products page should be displayed

Test Case Description: Verify invalid username and password handling
Test Steps: 1. Enter invalid username 2. Enter invalid password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Appropriate error message should be displayed

Test Case Description: Verify product names are displayed correctly
Test Steps: 1. Review the product names
Expected Result: Product names should be visible and correct

Test Case Description: Verify product prices are displayed correctly
Test Steps: 1. Review the product prices
Expected Result: Product prices should be displayed correctly

Test Case Description: Verify product descriptions are displayed
Test Steps: 1. Review the product descriptions
Expected Result: Product descriptions should be available

Test Case Description: Verify product sorting by name A to Z
Test Steps: 1. Open the sort dropdown 2. Select Name A to Z 3. Review the product list
Expected Result: Products should be sorted alphabetically from A to Z

Test Case Description: Verify product sorting by name Z to A
Test Steps: 1. Open the sort dropdown 2. Select Name Z to A 3. Review the product list
Expected Result: Products should be sorted alphabetically from Z to A

Test Case Description: Verify product sorting by price low to high
Test Steps: 1. Open the sort dropdown 2. Select Price low to high 3. Review the product list
Expected Result: Products should be sorted from lowest to highest price

Test Case Description: Verify product sorting by price high to low
Test Steps: 1. Open the sort dropdown 2. Select Price high to low 3. Review the product list
Expected Result: Products should be sorted from highest to lowest price

Test Case Description: Verify a product can be added to the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and Products page is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Select a product 2. Click Add to Cart 3. Open the cart
Expected Result: Selected product should appear in the cart

Test Case Description: Verify multiple products can be added to the cart
Preconditions: User is logged in and Products page is displayed
Test Steps: 1. Add two products to the cart 2. Open the cart
Expected Result: Both selected products should appear in the cart

Test Case Description: Verify a product can be removed from the cart
Preconditions: Product is present in the cart
Test Steps: 1. Open the cart 2. Click Remove for a selected product
Expected Result: Selected product should be removed from the cart

Test Case Description: Verify cart quantity is displayed correctly
Preconditions: Product is present in the cart
Test Steps: 1. Add a product to the cart 2. Review the cart badge
Expected Result: Cart should show the correct quantity
